gps_quality.spatial_rule_note: The 200 m threshold preserves the original declared first-pass gate. Passing it is necessary but not sufficient.
gps_quality.backtrack_rule_note: 20 m is the existing HMM observation-noise sigma used as an engineering tolerance, not an MBTA accuracy guarantee. Sensitivity counts at 1, 5, 20 and 50 m are reported.
gps_quality.speed_rule_note: 55 m/s preserves the pre-match segmentation ceiling; along-route speed is now checked separately and cannot be hidden by small lateral error.
gps_quality.accuracy_limit: MBTA V3 vehicle positions expose no per-point horizontal-accuracy field in these saved responses. No source-certified positional accuracy is claimed.

observation_window.baseline_method: first link remaining fraction plus complete intermediate occurrences plus final link traversed fraction
observation_window.same_occurrence_method: signed difference between final and first fractions on the same directed occurrence; negative progress is ineligible
observation_window.link_time_allocation: proportional to WKT along-link fraction; a model assumption, not per-link observation
observation_window.calibration_split_policy: reuse the previously published observation-to-split mapping; do not reassign holdout groups
observation_window.calibration_status_policy: corrected-data development diagnostic only because the old holdout has already been inspected

capacity_adapter.source_capacity_basis: GMNS link.schema.json capacity definition; source snapshot supplies no local config override
capacity_adapter.lane_basis: multiply source per-lane capacity by lanes exactly once
capacity_adapter.peak_load_factor_status: source value retained as an engineering period factor; all physical links equal 1.0; not independently calibrated
